dogecoin.text: Crypto, the only weekend proxy for liquidity, is getting hit hard: $BTC down 5.85%, $ETH down 9.95%, $DOGE down 13%, and $SHIB down 16.45%. Buyers beware.  The other high flyers: #Nikkei225, #NVDA & #QQQ will probably correct after the #BOJ raises rates this week.

Bitcoin, in fact, crypto in general, has stopped going up when the dollar goes down. This could be a move to fiat or the long-term correlation snapped. Not sure, but worth a look. $BTC $ETH $SOL $XRP $ADA $DOT $BNB $LTC $AVAX $MATIC $DOGE $SHIB
